meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先问你在做什么，据此提出一套记录分类（观察类型和概念标签），经你确认后写入本地 claude-mem 的 modes 目录并激活，还可选配 Telegram 提醒、重启 worker 并验证启动上下文。
howto.when: 当你要求定制 claude-mem 记住的内容、新建或修改 mode，或为特定记忆设置 Telegram 通知时触发，即使你不说“mode”这个词。

say.text: 帮我做一个记录法律学习要点的 mode
say.note: 它会先问你在做什么，再提出分类方案

say.text: 给这个 mode 加上 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 只对选中的观察类型或概念发提醒

say.text: 验证一下新 mode 是否已生效
say.note: 重启 worker 并检查启动上下文

howto.what_en: Claude asks about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, then installs and activates the mode in your local claude-mem data directory. It can also set up Telegram alerts, restart the worker, and verify the mode loads.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, or send Telegram alerts for particular memories — even without saying "mode."

say_en.text: Build me a mode that records law-study notes
say_en.note: It asks about your work first

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts to this mode
say_en.note: Only selected types or concepts trigger alerts

say_en.text: Verify the new mode is active
say_en.note: Restarts the worker and checks startup context
